output.reason: The only upstream evidence is one release-note line saying an AWSProvider.prefix field was added to AWS Secrets Manager [ev-61893aebc612]. Nothing in it or in the surrounding section says that any existing environment is affected. It doesn't say whether stores that leave the prefix unset behave any differently, so it doesn't support marking every SecretStore with spec.provider.aws set as exposed. It also doesn't settle the scope: whether the field applies only to the Secrets Manager service or to all of spec.provider.aws, and whether ClusterSecretStore is included too. Deciding this needs the PR or the docs that describe the field's semantics and its default behaviour when unset.
